mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'system_logs' AND PARTITION_NAME = #{partitionName}
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE system_logs REORGANIZE PARTITION p_future INTO ( PARTITION ${partitionName} VALUES LESS THAN ('${lessThanDate} 00:00:00'), PARTITION p_future VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE) )
